objective: Propose the implementation spec for fixing 4 Jin GUI Tasks/ToDo defects (DT-1..DT-4) plus a reusable JinModal/ConfirmDialog + JinSelect primitive, targeting jin-gui.

context_delta.summary: 7 stories. S1 JinModal base (self-hosting at #jin-modal-root, callback-wired buttons -> removes the Stimulus-scoping foot-gun that caused DT-2) + complete .action-dialog__* CSS. S2 ConfirmDialog->task delete. S3 edit-task + shared in-place due-date. S4 New List styling (DT-1). S5 JinSelect over native <select> (DT-3a). S6 list id/name canonicalization: fix name-assuming readers/writers, keep the correct id-based filter, add an id!=name test (DT-3b). S7 board view for sectionless lists (DT-4). Build S1 before S2/S3/S4; S1/S5/S6/S7 parallelizable. Key gates: real-index.html wiring tests (RISK-1) and the id!=name fixture.
